description: Controller declaration - confirm the class or every action has [Authorize]; a class with no [Authorize] and no [AllowAnonymous] is a candidate missing-auth finding
Explicit anonymous access - confirm it is intended (login/register/health) and not a hole
Entity loaded by id - check the query also filters by the caller's CompanyId/UserId (IDOR risk if not)
Role/privilege field on a bound request shape - mass-assignment / privilege-escalation candidate
Domain entity bound straight from the request body - mass assignment; bind a request DTO instead
Minimal-API route - confirm .RequireAuthorization() or a global fallback policy applies
